interface.title: Screenr v11.0.0 – Systematic Review Platform
interface.field: Evidence synthesis / clinical epidemiology (systematic reviews and meta-analysis)
interface.stage_of_work: Literature screening through data extraction, risk-of-bias appraisal, quantitative synthesis and reporting
interface.what_it_is_for: A browser-only workbench where a reviewer imports citation records, screens them, extracts study data and rates risk of bias, then pools effect sizes into a random-effects meta-analysis with forest, funnel, sensitivity and publication-bias outputs and a PRISMA 2020 diagram.

data.note: Most of the work used the built-in BCG vaccine example (13 trials, all already marked Include), loaded from the Quick Start Wizard's 'Try Example Data' card and later from Help > Load Example Dataset. The uploaded test file sample-records.ris also imported correctly (10 cardiology records, 'Imported 10 records'), but none of those records could be screened. Records were not kept after a page reload: the list came back empty (screens/055.webp). For the extraction test I typed a made-up trial results paragraph into the full-text box.

features.name: Random-effects pooling panel with estimator switch
features.general: Pool per-study estimates into one summary, pick the between-study variance method and a small-sample correction, and read heterogeneity statistics next to a per-study weight table
features.specific: Meta-Analysis dialog: τ² Estimator dropdown (DL, REML, Paule-Mandel, Sidik-Jonkman, Hedges, EB, ML, Hunter-Schmidt, Hartung-Makambi) and HKSJ checkbox; study table with effect, CI and weight; pooled effect, p, I² with CI, H², Q, τ²; method-comparison table. Choosing REML did not re-run the main result (still 'DL estimator'), and the REML row's τ² 4.2974 looks implausible
steps: Open the Meta tab
Press Settings to show the estimator controls
Choose a τ² estimator and toggle HKSJ (the main result did not update in this run)
Read the pooled estimate, heterogeneity and the method-comparison table
Open the sensitivity analyses
serves_tasks: Pool effect sizes and read heterogeneity

features.name: Forest plot
features.general: Show each study's estimate and interval on a shared axis, with a pooled diamond and labels saying which side favours which arm
features.specific: Forest Plot section of the Meta-Analysis dialog: squares and whiskers per study, 'effect [lo, hi]' text, Pooled diamond, Favors Treatment / Favors Control; linear axis, whiskers overlap study labels
steps: Run the pairwise meta-analysis
Scroll to the Forest Plot
Compare study intervals with the line of no effect and the pooled diamond
serves_tasks: Draw per-study and pooled estimates with confidence intervals

features.name: Sensitivity analysis tabs with report export
features.general: Re-run the pooled analysis leaving out one item at a time, adding items in order, flagging influential items and restricting to high-quality items, then export a text report
features.specific: Sensitivity Analyses dialog: Leave-One-Out, Cumulative (by year), Influence (DFBETAS > 2/√k), Risk of Bias restriction; Export Report
steps: Press Sensitivity Analysis in the Meta dialog
Switch between the Leave-One-Out, Cumulative, Influence and Risk of Bias tabs
Press Export Report to download a .txt summary
serves_tasks: Check how robust the pooled result is

features.name: Funnel plot with hover identification
features.general: Plot each study's effect against its standard error inside a pseudo-confidence funnel, and hover a point to see which study it is
features.specific: Synthesis > Funnel Plot: triangle funnel around the pooled effect; a native browser tooltip gives study label, effect and SE (not captured in screenshots)
steps: Open Synthesis > Funnel Plot
Look at the spread of points about the centre line
Hover an outlying point to identify the study
serves_tasks: Plot precision against effect to check asymmetry

features.name: Publication-bias test block

features.specific: Publication Bias Assessment section of the Meta-Analysis dialog: Egger's intercept with p, Begg's τ, Trim-and-Fill missing-study count

screens_never_reached: Record Details pane with title, abstract and the decision bar ('Skip to decisions' points to #decisionBar). Clicking or double-clicking a record card only highlights it; the pane always says 'Select a record' (screens/005.webp). The replay found record selection blocked while Batch Mode was on.
PICO analysis and Rule Matches for a record. These depend on a selected record, which never happened.
PICO Builder dialog. Choosing it from the Screening menu opened nothing (screens/054.webp).
Conflicts view with real disagreements and Adjudicator resolution. I could not make any screening decisions, so no conflicts were ever created.

Meta-Regression, Subgroup Analysis and PET-PEESE. With the 13 BCG studies loaded, they refused with 'Need at least 3 studies with effect sizes for meta-regression', 'Need at least 4 studies for subgroup analysis' and 'Need at least 3 studies for PET-PEESE' (screens/060.webp).
Machine-learning relevance ranking and the SAFE stopping rules (named by the review as a README section). Not opened; Run Auto-Screen had no visible effect (screens/059.webp).
Duplicate detection and removal. A Duplicates status chip exists in the records pane, but it was not opened.
Provenance tracking for extracted values (page, table, row) and dual independent extraction with adjudication. The Prov chips were seen, but the Provenance tab was never opened.
Quality checklists beside RoB 2.0 (CASP, Newcastle-Ottawa, Jadad, as listed in the review). Not opened.
Network MA, Bayesian, GOSH, Z-curve, Copas, GRADE, Summary of Findings, Protocol Builder, KM Curve Digitizer and the PDF tools: seen in the menus but not opened because I ran out of my action budget.
Save Project / Load Project and record or results export: not tried.
PubMed / CrossRef / OpenAlex / ClinicalTrials.gov search: not tried, since they need outbound network access.
not_done: Screening titles and abstracts one record at a time (decision bar and keyboard shortcuts). The shortcuts sheet lists I / E / M / D / N and arrow keys (screens/041.webp), but pressing i or e after selecting a record changed no counts, and ArrowDown did not move the selection (screens/009.webp).

Batch decisions. The Batch Mode checkboxes did not toggle when clicked (screens/045.webp). Select All Visible reported 'Selected 2 records', but Batch Exclude left the Exclude count at 0 (screens/053.webp); the replay saw the same with Batch Include. Run Auto-Screen also had no visible effect (screens/059.webp).

Resolving dual-screening conflicts. No decisions could be recorded, so no conflicts arose. The kappa panel only showed the degenerate BCG case: κ = 1.000 with '95% CI: [NaN, NaN]' and 100% expected by chance, where κ is undefined (screens/039.webp).

Rating a specific study's RoB. The RoB answers I gave produced a suggested 'LOW' for D1, but the RoB Summary still reported '0 of 13 included studies have RoB assessments' and an all-grey traffic-light plot. The answers seem not to attach to a study when no record is selected (screens/029.webp).

Effect Size Helper with the panel collapsed: pressing Calculate & Apply gave 'Provide valid event and total counts' (screens/035.webp); it worked once the panel was expanded and Load from Extraction was pressed.

Confirming that an extraction was saved and checking provenance. Save Extraction showed no confirmation (screens/038.webp); I did not check the Provenance tab or whether the extraction reached the meta-analysis.
Auto-extractor consistency. This run reported 'Extracted 8 fields'; the replay, on similar text, got 3 (Male %, follow-up, p) and missed N, age and the HR with CI. The difference is unexplained.
Exporting the meta-analysis results. Pressing Export Results in the Meta-Analysis dialog produced no download and no message.

Re-running the analysis with REML. After I chose REML, the heterogeneity block still read 'τ² … 0.3545 (DL estimator)' and the header said 'DL + HKSJ', so the estimator choice did not visibly re-run the main analysis (screens/014.webp). The method-comparison table's REML row (τ² 4.2974, CI 0.14–1.30) is also implausible: the point estimate lies outside its own CI.

Effect size converter interval. The 95% CI [1.156, 3.797] for OR 2.4766 is symmetric on the OR scale (2.4766 ± 1.96 × 0.6738) instead of being built on the log scale (which would give about [1.45, 4.22] from log-OR SE 0.272). This looks like a calculation problem, though I did not check the code.
Forest plot labels. Study names overlap the CI lines (screens/015.webp, screens/016.webp).
Exporting the PRISMA PNG: the SVG export worked (prisma-diagram.svg), but I did not try Export PNG.
Keeping the session. After a reload of the same origin the imported records were gone (screens/055.webp). I did not try Save Project / Load Project.
